implementationRequirements: Keep the two source editions as two different rule-table records and source catalogs.
Preserve all existing equipment IDs, field values, aliases, citations, PNGs, and historical reviews.
Keep the existing missile-range-adjustments rule as a separate, concise explanation; link the new table records to it only through explicit reviewed references.
Do not copy UA arrays into PHB fields or infer source-page values from a parallel table.
Use the source-table renderer's field contract and official citation helpers; a table row needs an exact focused source binding, while a table landing region needs context and no broad highlight.
Use source image overlays and separate independent final artifact review before any active source-grade change.
Do not include PHB p.39 distance-scale interpretation unless it is separately sourced and cited.
